title: How to Buy China Bullet-Train Tickets With No Chinese (2026) | China Travel Expert
description:
Riding China's high-speed rail as a foreigner is easier than it looks — and you never need to speak Chinese.

Every ticket is real-name and tied to your passport, so your passport literally becomes your ticket. Book the easy way on Trip.com (English interface, passport + international card), or use the official 12306 app, which now has a full English interface and accepts foreign-passport registration — just keep Alipay or WeChat Pay ready, since foreign-card payment on 12306 can be hit or miss. Tickets usually go on sale about 15 days before departure, you get an e-ticket, and at the station you simply scan your passport to reach the platform — no printing.

🧭 Expert Tip: The name you book under must match your boarding passport EXACTLY. China uses strict real-name ticketing — the ID used to buy must match the ID used to enter and board, or you'll be turned away.

在中国，护照就是你的高铁票——实名绑定，刷护照进站。
